沒有經驗從 45,000 元開始，通過健診評核後 50,000 元。收入拉開差距: With no experience you start at NT$45,000, rising to NT$50,000 after the Wellness Veterinarian assessment. Income spreads out at the attending stage.
抽成制度下，收入跟看診量與病患累積直接相關。初期有保底，但不會一進來就在高標。: Under a commission system, income is directly tied to caseload and accumulated patients. There is base pay early on, but you will not start at the top end.
主治考核通過後兩年才能申請種子計畫，計畫本身再兩到三年。病例要自己一個一個累積。: You can apply for the seed program two years after passing the attending assessment, and the program itself takes another two to three years. You build your cases one by one.
15 天連假是讓你能出國、能休息的彈性，不是額外的有薪假。: The 15-day break is flexibility to travel abroad or rest, not extra paid leave.
投保看實際薪資: Insurance is based on actual pay
以月薪 40,000 元計算，相較只用基本工資投保，每年勞退提撥多約 7,560: At a NT$40,000 monthly salary, compared with insuring only the minimum wage, pension contributions are about NT$7,560 higher each year, and maternity, injury, and retirement benefits are also calculated on actual insured pay.
獸醫醫事助理人力會隨營運調整: Veterinary medical assistant staffing varies with operations
各院的獸醫醫事助理人數與排班會隨營運變動，不一定每個時段都完全充足，這點我們不做: Each hospital’s veterinary medical assistant headcount and schedules vary with operations and are not always fully sufficient in every time slot; we do not over-promise on this. The Education Center continues to help train professional veterinary medical assistants, and you are welcome to ask about a hospital’s current assistant staffing in your interview.See veterinary medical assistant development →
應徵前，你可能想問的事: Questions you may have before applying
點選問題看答案。沒找到想問的，填表單或寄信給教育中心，我們會直接回覆你。: Select a question to see the answer. If you do not find yours, fill in the form or email the Education Center and we will reply directly.
連鎖醫院會不會有業績壓力？會被要求推檢查嗎？: Is there performance pressure in a hospital chain? Will I be asked to push tests?
老實說，任何醫院都有營收壓力，我們也一樣。營收是每間醫院維持營運、持續投入醫療與: Honestly, every hospital has revenue pressure, and so do we. Revenue is the foundation that keeps each hospital running and keeps investing in care and teams, so we can give patients better care and give colleagues’ hard work a fairer return.
我們希望做到的是，在這個現實之下，透過更清楚、透明的制度，讓每個人的專業、付出與: What we want to do, within that reality, is use a clearer, more transparent system so everyone’s expertise, effort, and contribution is seen and fairly rewarded. Clinical judgment, communication with owners, and the care you put into mentoring newcomers all count; commission rules are explained upfront and calculations are itemized and checkable. So everyone knows that their effort accumulates and leads somewhere.
看診時，我們在意的是做醫療該做的事：依病情提出合理的選項、把原因和費用說清楚，陪: In the exam room, what we care about is doing what care should do: offering reasonable options based on the condition, explaining reasons and costs clearly, and helping animals and their families reach the most appropriate choice together.
醫療決策是醫師自己決定，還是照 SOP？: Do veterinarians make medical decisions themselves, or follow SOPs?
以國際醫療指引為依據，例如 ACVIM 等專科共識。醫師在指引的基礎上依個別病例: We rely on international clinical guidelines, such as specialty consensus statements from ACVIM. Veterinarians use their own judgment on individual cases within those guidelines; for complex cases you can consult colleagues or bring them to Guideline and M&M rounds to discuss together.
遇到醫療糾紛，醫院會怎麼支援？: If there is a medical dispute, how does the hospital support me?
有客服團隊支援，協助與飼主溝通並處理後續，醫師不需要獨自面對。病例也可以帶到臨床: A customer service team helps communicate with owners and handle follow-up, so veterinarians do not face it alone. The case can also be brought to a difficult-case conference (M&M) for review, to find a better approach next time.
美國院有交流或外派的機會嗎？: Are there exchange or overseas assignment opportunities with the U.S. hospital?
有。加入體系、認真投入的醫師，有機會獲得外派到<a href=\"#usa\">: Yes. Veterinarians who join the network and commit seriously may get the chance to be assigned to the California hospital.
沒有經驗可以應徵嗎？: Can I apply with no experience?
可以。無經驗起薪 45,000 元，通過健診醫師評核後調升至 50,000 元。: Yes. Starting pay with no experience is NT$45,000, rising to NT$50,000 after passing the Wellness Veterinarian assessment. See Pay & benefits for details.
主治醫師的收入怎麼算？可以核對嗎？: How is an attending’s income calculated? Can I check it?
主治採高保底、高抽成，收入區間約 6–18 萬。抽成規則事先說明，業績歸屬與計算: Attendings have high base pay plus high commission, with income of roughly NT$60,000–180,000. Commission rules are explained upfront, revenue attribution and calculations are itemized and checkable, and there is a clear way to verify and correct them.
一個月排幾班？加班怎麼算？: How many shifts a month? How is overtime handled?
採四週排班與變形工時，主治週工時約 40 小時，排班可與同事協調。超時正常給付加: We use four-week rosters and flexible hours; attendings work about 40 hours a week, with schedules open to coordination with colleagues. Overtime is paid as required, and you can also apply for compensatory time off. The overnight shift is 160 hours per 4 weeks, about 16 shifts.
依法提供特休，生日當月有生日假。年資滿一年可向院長申請 15 天喘息連假（不帶薪: Annual leave is provided as required by law, with birthday leave in your birth month. After one year of service you can apply to your director for a 15-day respite break (unpaid), once a year.
剛到職的第一個月會做什麼？有人帶嗎？: What will I do in my first month? Will someone guide me?
有。學長姐會帶你跟診、旁診觀摩，看診後給回饋；導生關懷制度也會安排導師，從適應工: Yes. Seniors take you along on cases and observation, and give feedback afterward. The mentor care program also assigns a mentor, so someone accompanies you from settling in to finding a specialty direction.
從住院醫師到主治大概要多久？: How long from resident to attending?
參考時間是住院醫師約 3–6 個月、健診醫師約 6–9 個月，之後成為主治醫師。: For reference, about 3–6 months as a resident and 6–9 months as a Wellness Veterinarian, then you become an attending. Actual timing adjusts to each person’s progress and assessment results; see the Career ladder.
想發展專科，要怎麼申請？: I want to develop a specialty. How do I apply?
主治醫師考核通過兩年後，可以申請專科種子醫師計畫，例如<a href=\"#ey: Two years after passing the attending assessment, you can apply for a specialty seed program, such as the ophthalmology seed program. The program lasts about two to three years, and you can begin seeing specialty cases independently in year two.
各院設備不同，遇到需要進階檢查的病例怎麼辦？: Equipment differs by hospital. What if a case needs advanced testing?
仁武總院有 24H 夜間急診、CT 與內視鏡，是各院的醫療後盾。需要時可以轉院或: The Renwu Main Hospital has 24-hour overnight emergency care, CT, and endoscopy, and serves as the medical backbone for all branches. When needed you can refer or consult across hospitals, so you do not have to handle it alone.
